name: Executioner
summary: Executioner; Your attacks against frightened, prone, or restrained creatures deal +1d6 damage.  Executioner; Your Executioner damage becomes +1d8.  Executioner; Once per turn, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, another hostile creature within 30 ft must make a Wisdom save or become frightened until your next turn.  Executioner; Judgement Protocol deals an extra +2d6 damage.
descriptionMarkdown:
Executioner; Your attacks against frightened, prone, or restrained creatures deal +1d6 damage.

Executioner; Your Executioner damage becomes +1d8.

Executioner; Once per turn, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, another hostile creature within 30 ft must make a Wisdom save or become frightened until your next turn.

Executioner; Judgement Protocol deals an extra +2d6 damage.
